blocks.text: Arteries, veins aur capillaries insani daurani nizam ki bari khoon ki naliyan hain.

blocks.title: Neele bachche (blue babies)
blocks.text: Kuch ghair-mamooli bachchon ki jild neeli (cyanosis) hoti hai: blue babies. Yeh dono atria ke darmiyan oxygenated aur deoxygenated khoon ke milne se hota hai, to jism ko mila hua khoon milta hai. Cyanosis nashonuma ke dauran interatrial foramen, embryonic dil mein daen aur baen atria ke darmiyan ek aarzi surakh, ke band na hone se hoti hai; yeh ductus arteriosus, embryonic pulmonary artery aur aorta ke darmiyan ek aarzi nali, ke poori tarah na sukarne se bhi ho sakti hai.
Arteries (shiryanein)

Arteries khoon ko dil se jism ke mukhtalif hisson tak le jati hain; pulmonary arteries ke siwa sab oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Artery ka markazi khala lumen hai, aur is ki deewar ki teen tahein hain: connective aur elastic tissue ki bairooni tunica externa ya adventitia, moti azlati (muscular) tissue aur elastic reshon ki darmiyani tunica media, aur endothelial cells ki patli tah, andarooni tunica intima. Darmiyani tah aham hai kyunke yeh ventricular systole ke zyada khoon ke dabao ko bardasht kar sakti hai. Arteries chhoti naliyon, arterioles, mein batti hain, jo baar baar bat kar bohat bareek shakhon ka ghana jaal, capillaries, banati hain.

blocks.alt: Kati hui artery seedhi-dar belanon (cylinders) ki shakal mein: beech mein lumen, jis par tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah hai; is ke gird smooth muscles aur elastic tissue wala tunica media; aur sab se bahar mota tunica externa, jis se arterioles nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.6: Artery ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.6 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Lumen, Tunica intima (endothelium), Smooth muscles, Elastic tissue, Tunica media, Tunica externa, Arterioles.

blocks.text: Capillaries

Capillaries arterioles ke batne se banti aur mil kar venules banati hain. Yeh tamam tissues mein dakhil ho kar cells ki satah tak pohnchti hain. In ki deewarein endothelial cells ki ek tah hain aur andarooni qutr qareeb 8 micrometre hai. Capillaries woh jagahein hain jahan khoon aur jism ke tissues ke darmiyan maddon ka tabadla diffusion ya active transport se hota hai: pani aur diffuse hone wale maddey capillary ki deewaron se, endothelial cells ke zariye ya un ke darmiyani khalon se, guzarte hain, aur kuch maddey deewar ke cells endocytosis se lete aur exocytosis se doosri taraf dete hain. Capillaries ke andar ka dabao plasma se tissues mein mayah ka musalsal rasao karta hai; yeh interstitial fluid pani par mushtamil hai jis mein hal shuda nutrients, hormones, gaisein, fuzla aur chhote proteins hain. Bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillaries ke andar rehte hain, magar kuch WBCs deewar ke darmiyani khalon se nikal sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Capillary ek tang tube jis ki deewar chapte endothelial cells ki sirf ek tah hai; khule sire par ek red blood cell lumen ka zyada hissa bhar raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.7: Capillary ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.7 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Kitni qareeb aur kitni lambi
blocks.text: Jism ka koi cell capillary se 100 micrometre se zyada door nahin. Capillaries itni tang hain ke RBCs unhen ek qatar mein paar karte hain, aur balig ki capillaries ki kul lambai 80,600 kilometre se zyada andazi gai hai, jo zameen ke gird do chakkar ke liye kafi hai.
Veins (wareedein)

Veins khoon ko jism ke mukhtalif hisson se dil ki taraf le jati hain; pulmonary veins ke siwa sab deoxygenated khoon le jati hain. In ki deewaron mein arteries jaisi teen tahein hain: connective aur elastic tissue ki tunica externa, nisbatan patli aur halki si azlati tunica media jis mein kam elastic reshe hain, aur endothelial cells ki tunica intima. Darmiyani tah arteries se patli hai kyunke veins ko zyada dabao bardasht nahin karna parta; khali artery phir bhi khokhli nali rehti hai, magar khali vein khali ghubbare ki tarah beth jati hai. Veins mein semilunar valves khoon ke dil ki taraf jate hue wapsi rokte hain, aur gird ke pathon ke sukarne ka dabao veins ko daba kar khoon ki wapsi mein madad karta hai. Chhoti veins mil kar bari veins aur aakhir venae cavae (inferior aur superior) banati hain, jo khoon daen atrium mein dalti hain; phephron se pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.

blocks.alt: Kati hui vein seedhi-dar belanon ki shakal mein: chaura lumen jis ke andar valve hai, tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah; smooth muscles ka patla tunica media; aur bahari tunica externa, jis mein pehlu se venule milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.8: Vein ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.8 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Valve, Tunica intima (endothelium), Lumen, Smooth muscles, Tunica media, Tunica externa, Venule.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Artery (Figure 11.6) se muqabla karein: vein ka tunica media patla aur lumen chaura hai, aur us mein valve hai jo khoon ko wapas behne nahin deta.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf surkh artery se arterioles nikalti hain; har capillary loop ke shuru mein precapillary sphincter hai. Jamni capillaries arterioles ko venules se jorti hain, jo daen taraf neeli vein mein khulti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.9: Arterioles, capillaries aur venules ka talluq (textbook ki Figure 11.9 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Artery, Arteriole, Precapillary sphincters, Capillaries, Venule, Vein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khoon ka rasta: artery -> arteriole -> capillaries -> venule -> vein. Rang surkh (oxygenated) se neela (deoxygenated) hota jata hai kyunke capillaries mein oxygen tissues ko di jati hai.
Capillaries mein khoon ke bahao ka intizam

Capillaries mein behne wale khoon ki miqdar unhen sukar kar ya phaila kar qaboo hoti hai: aasabi tehreek capillaries ko sukar sakti aur histamine jaise kuch kimiyai maddey unhen phaila sakte hain. Kuch capillaries doosri capillaries ke loops ke zariye arterioles aur venules se juri hain, aur har loop ke daakhle par muscle ka ek halqa, precapillary sphincter, hai jo capillaries se behne wale khoon ki miqdar qaboo karta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar arteriole aur neeche venule, chhe capillary loops se jure jo arteriole ke qareeb surkh aur venule ke qareeb neele hain. Har loop ke arteriole se nikalne ki jagah challa (ring) numa pre-capillary sphincter hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.10: Pre-capillary sphincters (textbook ki Figure 11.10 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Arteriole, Pre-capillary sphincter, Capillaries, Venule.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sphincter sukre to us loop mein khoon kam jata hai, dheela ho to zyada. Is tarah jism zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon bheejta hai.
Arterioles mein vasoconstriction aur vasodilation

Arterioles ki deewaron mein elastic tissue se zyada gol (circular) muscles hain, aur in ka sukarna aasabi aur endocrine nizamon ke qaboo mein hai. Jab yeh muscles sukarte hain to arterioles tang hoti hain, vasoconstriction mein, jo un mein khoon ka bahao kam karti hai; jab dheele hote hain to arterioles phailti hain, vasodilation mein, jo bahao barhati hai. Vasoconstriction aur vasodilation tissues ki metabolic sargarmi ki tabdeeli ke jawab mein hoti hain: jab kisi tissue mein sargarmi barhti hai to us ke interstitial fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hoti hai, us ki arterioles ke circular muscles dheele hote hain (vasodilation), aur arterioles aur capillaries mein barha hua bahao zyada oxygen deta aur zyada carbon dioxide hatata hai. Isi tarah kam metabolic sargarmi arterioles ki vasoconstriction karti hai.

blocks.alt: Faal (active) tissue cells ki qatar ke neeche do arterioles. Baen: tang arteriole jis se capillaries mein normal blood flow hai; oopar tissue fluid mein oxygen zyada hai. Daen: tissue fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hai, aur chauri phaili (dilated) arteriole capillaries mein zyada khoon le jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.11: Vasodilation (textbook ki Figure 11.11 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Active tissue, Less oxygen, More carbon dioxide, Normal blood flow, Capillaries, Increased blood flow, dilated arteriole.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tissue zyada kaam kare to O2 kam aur CO2 zyada hoti hai; is ke jawab mein arteriole ke circular muscles dheele hote hain (vasodilation) aur zyada khoon aa kar zyada O2 deta hai.
Khoon ke bahao ki raftar

Khoon ke bahao ki raftar mukhtalif naliyon mein mukhtalif hai. Yeh aorta mein sab se zyada (450 se 500 mm fi second) hai, arteries aur arterioles ke jaal mein girti hai, aur capillaries mein sab se kam (qareeb 1 mm fi second); venules, veins aur venae cavae mein phir barhti hai (250 se 300 mm fi second). Raftar ki yeh tabdeeliyan naliyon ke nizam ke kul cross-section ki tabdeeli se hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Graph jis ke y-axis par khoon ki raftar (mm/sec) 0 se 500 tak aur x-axis par aorta, arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, veins aur vena cava ki rangeen pattiyan hain. Peeli lakeer aorta mein qareeb 480 se shuru ho kar arteries aur arterioles mein girti hai, capillaries mein taqreeban sifar ho jati hai, phir venules aur veins mein barh kar vena cava mein qareeb 270 tak aati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.12: Mukhtalif naliyon mein khoon ki raftar (textbook ki Figure 11.12 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Capillaries ka majmui cross-section sab se zyada hai, is liye wahan khoon sab se aahista chalta hai aur tabadle ke liye waqt milta hai. Textbook ka '01 mm/sec' asal mein taqreeban 1 mm/sec hai.
Daurani raste

Insanon mein, aur tamam mammals aur parindon mein, khoon do bare raston mein daura karta hai: pulmonary circulation, phephron tak aur wapas, aur systemic circulation, jism ke baqi hisson tak aur wapas.

blocks.alt: Beech mein dil. Pulmonary circulation: pulmonary arteries (neeli) khoon ko daen aur baen phephron ke capillary beds tak le jati hain aur right aur left pulmonary veins (surkh) wapas lati hain. Systemic circulation: aorta (surkh) khoon ko oopar baazuon aur sar, aur neeche andaruni aza aur tangon tak le jati hai; superior aur inferior vena cava (neeli) wapas late hain. Teer rukh aur brackets dono circulations dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.13: Pulmonary aur systemic circulations (textbook ki Figure 11.13 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Superior vena cava, Arms and head, Aorta, Pulmonary arteries, Right lung, Left lung, Right pulmonary vein, Left pulmonary vein, Internal organs, Inferior vena cava, Legs, Systemic circulation, Pulmonary circulation.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: pulmonary arteries mein deoxygenated aur pulmonary veins mein oxygenated khoon hota hai, systemic naliyon ka ulta.
Pulmonary circulation

Pulmonary circulation phephron ko deoxygenated khoon deti aur oxygenated khoon dil ko lautati hai. Pulmonary trunk, ek bari artery, daen ventricle se deoxygenated khoon le jati aur daen aur baen pulmonary arteries mein bat kar dono phephron tak jati hai. Har phephre ke andar pulmonary artery pulmonary arterioles aur phephre ki capillaries mein batti hai, jahan khoon oxygenated hota hai. Phephre ki capillaries mil kar pulmonary venules banati hain, jo mil kar pulmonary veins banati hain; baen aur daen pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.
Systemic circulation
Systemic circulation phephron ke siwa jism ke tamam cells, tissues aur aza ko oxygenated khoon deti aur deoxygenated khoon dil ko lautati hai. Is ke yeh ajza hain.

items: Coronary circulation: dil ki deewaron ko systemic circulation ke ek chhote hisse se khoon milta hai. Daen aur baen coronary arteries aorta se us ki ibtida ke qareeb nikalti hain aur chhoti arteries, arterioles aur capillaries mein batti hain. Dil ke pathon ko oxygenated khoon dene ke baad capillaries mil kar venules banati hain jo bohat si coronary veins banati hain, jo mil kar coronary sinus banati hain jo daen atrium mein khulta hai; chhoti coronary veins seedhi daen atrium mein nikasi karti hain.

blocks.alt: Dil ke do manzar, oopar vena cava aur aorta. Saamne ka manzar (anterior): left aur right coronary arteries aorta ki jarr se nikal kar dil ki deewar par shakhein banati hain, saath coronary veins. Peeche ka manzar (posterior): coronary veins oopar ja kar bari coronary sinus mein milti hain jo dil ki pusht par se guzarti hai, aur saath right coronary artery hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.14: Coronary circulation (textbook ki Figure 11.14 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Left coronary artery, Right coronary artery, Coronary veins, Coronary sinus, Right coronary artery, (Anterior view), (Posterior view).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Coronary sinus right atrium mein khulti hai. Dil ki apni deewar ko khoon in coronary arteries se milta hai, chambers ke khoon se nahin.

items: Hepatic portal circulation: portal system woh daura hai jis mein veins capillaries par khatm hoti hain. Hepatic portal system mein ek bari hepatic portal vein tilli (spleen) aur alimentary canal se khoon jama kar ke jigar tak le jati hai, jahan se hepatic veins use dil tak le jati hain. Alimentary canal se aane wale khoon mein chhoti aant se jazb shuda maddey hain, jo dil se pehle jigar se guzarte hain; jigar nuqsan-deh maddey hata deta aur nutrients zakheere ke liye jazb karta hai. Yeh nizam oesophagus ke nichle hisse se anal canal ke oopri hisse tak phaila hai.

blocks.alt: Jigar (liver) aur us ke saath maida, tilli (spleen) aur pancreas, aur neeche colon chhoti aant ko ghere hue. Chhoti aant, colon, pancreas aur spleen ki veins mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain, jo jigar mein ja kar shakhein banati hai. Hepatic veins jigar se khoon inferior vena cava mein le jati hain, jo beech mein oopar jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.15: Hepatic portal system (textbook ki Figure 11.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Inferior vena cava, Hepatic veins, Spleen, Pancreas, Hepatic portal vein, Ascending colon, Descending colon, Small intestine.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Portal system mein vein capillaries se shuru ho kar doosri capillaries (jigar mein) par khatm hoti hai. Is liye aant se jazb hone wali cheezein pehle jigar se guzarti hain.

items: Renal circulation: daen aur baen renal arteries gurdon (kidneys) tak oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Gurde ke andar har renal artery baar baar bat kar chhoti arteries banati hai, jo kai afferent arterioles mein batti hain jo nephrons (gurde ki ikaiyan) ko khoon deti hain. Har afferent arteriole ek glomerulus ki capillaries mein batti hai, jo mil kar efferent arteriole banati hain; yeh capillaries ke do set mein batti hai, cortex mein nephron ki nali ke gird peritubular capillaries aur medulla mein nali ke gird vasa recta. Yeh capillaries mil kar venules banati hain, jo chhoti veins aur aakhir renal vein banati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron aur us ki khoon ki faraahmi. Chhoti artery afferent arteriole deti hai jo glomerulus banati hai; efferent arteriole us se nikal kar lipti tubule ke gird peri-tubular capillaries aur loop ke saath vasa recta banati hai; venule chhoti vein mein khulti hai. Daen: gurde ki qash jis mein renal artery se chhoti arteries phailti hain aur renal vein bahar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.16: Renal circulation (textbook ki Figure 11.16 ke mutabiq asal drawing; kitab mein caption 'Renal portal system' chhapi hai).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Peri-tubular capillaries, Efferent arteriole, Glomerulus, Afferent arteriole, Smaller arteries, Vasa recta, Venule, Smaller vein, Renal vein, Renal artery.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Textbook is figure ki caption 'Renal portal system' chhapti hai, magar insaan mein renal portal system nahin hota (yeh machhli aur amphibians mein hota hai); kitab ka apna heading 'Renal Circulation' hai. Yahan afferent arteriole -> glomerulus -> efferent arteriole -> peri-tubular capillaries/vasa recta -> venule -> renal vein ka raasta hai, is liye caption 'Renal circulation' likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Portal system ghair-mamooli kyun hai, aur hepatic portal system jism ko kya faida deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar circuits mein vein khoon seedha dil ko lautati hai, magar portal system mein vein capillaries ke doosre bed par khatm hoti hai. Hepatic portal vein tilli aur alimentary canal ka khoon, jo chhoti aant mein abhi jazb shuda maddon se bhara hai, pehle jigar ki capillaries mein le jati hai, taake jigar nuqsan-deh maddey hata aur nutrients zakheera kar sake, phir hepatic veins khoon dil aur baqi jism tak bhejti hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Arteries (moti azlati tunica media, zyada dabao) arterioles, capillaries (ek cell moti, 8 micrometre, tabadla, interstitial fluid bahar risti hai), venules aur veins (patli media, valves, khali ho kar beth jati hain) se venae cavae aur daen atrium tak le jati hain.

Bahao precapillary sphincters, asaab aur histamine se, aur tissue ki oxygen aur carbon dioxide ke jawab mein azlati arterioles ki vasoconstriction ya vasodilation se tai hota hai. Raftar: aorta 450-500 mm/s, capillaries qareeb 1 mm/s, venae cavae 250-300 mm/s, kul cross-section ke mutabiq.

Pulmonary circulation: daen ventricle, pulmonary trunk aur arteries, phephre ki capillaries, pulmonary veins, baen atrium. Systemic circulation mein coronary (aorta se coronary sinus), hepatic portal (aant aur tilli se jigar se hepatic veins) aur renal (afferent arteriole, glomerulus, efferent arteriole, peritubular capillaries aur vasa recta, renal vein) circuits shamil hain.
